en: Multiview color postcard showing five landmark views of Craiova, Romania, with a civic crest at upper left. Images depict the county administrative palace, the University of Craiova, the Museum of Art (Jean Mihail Palace), the statue of Alexandru Ioan Cuza, and the municipal council (city hall). The reverse has Romanian printed template fields, two Posta Romana stamps and a Bucharest postmark, a handwritten Romanian message, and the addressee's Bucharest address.
